newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: El Salvador to issue bonds to refinance IMF loan.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador to issue bonds to refinance IMF loan.

text.p: El Salvador will issue $200 million in seven-year bonds to refinance a short-term debt with the International Monetary Fund (IMF), the president of the central bank said Wednesday.
Roberto Orellana told the daily newspaper Diario de Hoy that the bonds would be used to refinance $150 million of one-year Salvadoran treasury notes, known as LETES, issued in 1996 through the IMF.
"Short-term debt is being refinanced over a more adequate maturity," Orellano said, adding ther issue date has not yet been defined.
"On placing the bonds abroad, the LETES will be cancelled," he added.
